name: Emoji Sentences: Egypt Edition
desc: Everyday Egyptian phrases at the low values, Egyptian proverbs higher up. Answer in Egyptian Arabic.

100: Kol sana w enta tayeb: many happy returns
Teshrab eh? What will you drink?
Nawwart: you've lit up the place (welcome)
200: Na'eeman: said after a haircut or a shower
Bel hana wel shefa: enjoy your meal
Alf mabrouk: a thousand congratulations
Salamtak: get well soon
Khamsa w khmeesa: against the evil eye
Ba'd shwaya: in a little while
Yarhamkom Allah: said after a sneeze
'Ein el hasood: the envious eye
Ya basha: hey boss
El 'agala men el shaytan: haste is from the devil
Sabah el fol: good morning (lit. morning of jasmine)
Hader: right away, at your service
Ya nhar eswed: oh no! (lit. what a black day)
Ana fel sekka: I'm on my way
Shobbeik lobbeik: your wish is my command
Ya reit: I wish
Etfaddal: please, go ahead (help yourself)
Tesbah 'ala kheir: good night
Hamdellah 'al salama: welcome back safely
Fakka? Got change?
Shwaya shwaya: slowly, slowly
Harr nar: it's boiling hot
300: 'Asfour fel eid wala 'ashara 'al shagara: a bird in the hand beats ten in the tree
Elli 'ayez el 'asal yesbor 'ala 'arsat el nahl: if you want honey, put up with the stings
Elli 'ala rasso batha byhassis 'aleiha: the guilty one feels for the duck on his head
Ghab el 'ott, el'ab ya far: the cat's away, play, mouse
Edi el 'eish le khabbazo walaw kal nosso: give the bread to its baker even if he eats half
E'mel el kheir w armeeh fel bahr: do good and throw it in the sea
El kalam men fadda wel sokout men dahab: speech is silver, silence is gold
Kol 'o'da w laha hallal: every knot has someone to untie it
Elli ma ye'rafsh yor'os y'ool el ard 'awga: can't dance, so he blames the crooked floor
Bokra fel meshmesh: tomorrow, in apricot season (never)
'Eish w malh: bread and salt (the bond of people who've shared food)
Dammak khafeef: you're funny (lit. your blood is light)
Dammak te'eel: you're annoying (lit. your blood is heavy)
'Ala fekra: by the way (lit. on an idea)
Wesh el kheir: a bringer of good luck
Shedd helak: hang in there, stay strong
Elli yebos le fo' yet'ab: whoever keeps looking up (at others' luck) wears himself out
Kol sheikh w loh tari'a: every sheikh has his own way
Mer'at el hobb 'amya: love's mirror is blind
Elli yezra' yehsod: whoever plants, harvests
El samak el kebeer yakol el soghayar: the big fish eats the small
El 'ein btakol 'abl el bo': the eye eats before the mouth
400: Elli tegeeh men el sama testa'belha el ard: what comes from the sky, the earth accepts
El sabr moftah el farag: patience is the key to relief
Tele' men el moled bela hommos: left the moulid without chickpeas (came away with nothing)
Gat el hazina tefrah malaatlahash matrah: the sad woman came to celebrate and found no seat
El maya tekdab el ghattas: the water gives the lie to the diver
Ba'd ma kharbet Malta: after Malta was ruined (too late)
Kol fula w laha kayyal: every bean has someone to measure it
El ghayeb hogeto ma'ah: the absent one has his excuse
Elli ma yeshoofsh men el gharbal yeb'a a'ma: if you can't see through a sieve, you're blind
Sab' sanaye' wel bakht dayee': seven trades and no luck
Lesanak hosanak: your tongue is your horse (guard it and it guards you)
Elli eido fel maya mesh zay elli eido fel nar: a hand in water isn't like a hand in fire
Bab el naggar mekhalla': the carpenter's door is broken
El hama 'a'raba: the mother-in-law is a scorpion
El eid el wahda ma tesa'afsh: one hand can't clap
Ahl Makka adra be she'abha: Mecca's people know its paths best
El bab elli ygilak meno el rih, seddo w estrayah: shut the door the wind comes through and rest
El gar 'abl el dar: choose the neighbour before the house
Elli ma'hoosh ma yelzamhoosh: if you can't afford it, you don't need it
Lamma te'a' el ba'ara tekter sakakinha: when the cow falls, the knives multiply
Akbar menak b youm, a'raf menak b sana: a day older than you, a year wiser
Ebn el wezz 'awwam: the duckling is born a swimmer
500: El shams ma tetghattash bel gharbal: you can't cover the sun with a sieve
Elli fel 'edra yetall'oh el ma'la'a: what's in the pot, the ladle brings out
El 'a'l zeina: good sense is an ornament
Ya ma gab el ghorab le ommo: look how much the crow brought its mother (nothing at all)
Elli banu Masr kanu fel asl halawany: the people who built Egypt were originally confectioners
Elli malosh kbeer yeshteriloh kbeer: if you have no elder, buy one
El nas ma'amat: people have their ranks
Sabah el kheir ya gari, enta f halak w ana f hali: good morning, neighbour, you mind yours and I'll mind mine
Orbot el homar matrah ma ye'oolak sahbo: tie the donkey where its owner tells you
El gamal ma yeshoofsh 'ewegt ra'abto: the camel can't see its own crooked neck
Kalam el leil madhoon bel zebda, yetla' 'aleih el nahar yesih: night talk is buttered, daylight melts it
Ma yesla'h el 'attar ma afsado el dahr: the perfumer can't fix what time has ruined
El mayya ma tetla'sh fel 'aali: water doesn't flow uphill
Ya bakht men bat mazloum wala bat zalem: lucky is he who sleeps wronged, not as the wrongdoer
Elli yekhaf men el 'afreet yetla'lo: whoever fears the demon, it appears to him
Elli yzammar ma yghattish da'no: whoever plays the pipe can't hide his chin
In gak el tofan, hott ebnak taht reglek: if the flood comes, put your son under your feet
Kollo 'and el 'arab saboon: it's all soap to the Arabs (it's all the same)
Yet'allem el hela'a fi roos el yatama: he learns barbering on orphans' heads
Elli ma yerdash bel khokh yerda be sharabo: whoever refuses the peach ends up taking its juice
Zay el ottat, takol w tenkar: like cats, they eat and deny it
Elli ma ye'rafak yeghhalak: whoever doesn't know you underrates you
